newsitem.title: USA: Oil union to issue strike warning to Unocal.
newsitem.headline: Oil union to issue strike warning to Unocal.

text.p: The union representing workers at four Unocal Corp refiners in California said late Wednesday it would soon issue a three-day strike warning against the company, citing disagreement over how to close out its contract before Tosco Corp assumes ownership.
Unocal Corp will own the four California plants until Tosco takes over on March 31.

Union officials, who earlier rejected a final contract offer from Tosco, said they may strike against current owner Unocal because the company has failed to firm up certain retirement and pay benefits before they end their contract.
"The union has given its negotiating committee a strike notice and has unanimously rejected Tosco's offer," said Howard Spencer, a local union president.
About 900 members of the union work at the four Unocal refineries.
Union officials say they are also concerned the four plants would not run safely if Tosco's proposed 15 percent staff cut goes through.
"We feel the safety issue is big," Spencer said.
But if members strike, officials said they will keep trying to negotiate a new contract with Tosco.
"We're ready to work for them," Spencer said.
